title: Describing words
examples: Can you tell me what an adjective is?
How do I use describing words?

explain.say: Today we are learning about describing words for things.

items: Words tell us more about nouns

explain.say: A describing word tells us what something is like.
Let us look at the word big. Big tells us about size.
Next we have soft. Soft tells us how something feels to touch.
The word shiny tells us about how something looks in the light.
Look at this bright red ball. We can use describing words like big and shiny.

faq.q: What is the difference between a describing word and a naming word?
faq.a: A naming word is a person place or thing. A describing word tells us more about that thing.
asks: Can you give me an example of a describing word?
Does a describing word name something?

faq.q: Can I use describing words at the beginning of a sentence?
faq.a: Yes you can. You can start a sentence with a describing word. For example, soft grass is nice.
asks: Is it okay to start with 'blue'?
Can adjectives go first in a sentence?

faq.q: Do I need to use a describing word every time?
faq.a: No you do not. Sometimes the simple word is enough. But using them makes your talking much better.
asks: Is it always best to describe things?

faq.q: What kind of things can describing words describe?
faq.a: They can describe people animals or objects. They tell us about size color or how it feels.
asks: Can I describe feelings with these words?
Do they only describe things I can see?

faq.q: Are 'big' and 'large' the same describing word?
faq.a: They mean almost the same thing. Both words tell us that something is of a great size.
asks: Can I swap them in a sentence?

facts: Describing words are also called adjectives.
They tell us more about nouns.
Words like big soft and shiny are adjectives.
Adjectives can describe size color and feeling.

quiz.why: Fluffy describes how the cat's fur feels.

wrong.1: Sleepy describes a feeling, but fluffy describes the fur.
wrong.2: Running is an action word, not a describing word.
wrong.3: Blue is a color, but fluffy describes the texture.

quiz.say: Which word describes the size of the apple?
quiz.why: Big tells us that the apple is large in size.

wrong.0: Soft tells us about touch, not size.
wrong.1: Red is a color, not a size word.
wrong.3: Shiny tells us about light, not size.

quiz.say: Which word correctly describes a new toy car?
quiz.why: Shiny tells us that the car reflects light brightly.

wrong.0: Big only tells us about size, not how it looks.
wrong.1: Sleepy describes a feeling, not a toy.
wrong.3: Soft means gentle to touch, which a car is not.
